system.description:
Range unlimited, even across planes; one creature you know, which must be asleep or fall asleep within 24 hours (the spell waits). Choose one: Converse, entering its dream for up to 8 hours and showing scenes you choose; Implant, planting one command of up to 25 words, as Suggestion (Will negates; lasts until fulfilled, up to 1 week); or Nightmare: Will negates; on a failure it takes 6d10 psychic damage, gains 2 levels of Exhaustion (maximum 5, fading as normal) and regains no HP or spells from that rest; on a success it takes half damage and no Exhaustion.

Classes: Illusionist
